dimensions.assessment: Reaches tenants living in federally assisted rental dwelling units and properties with federally backed mortgages nationwide.
dimensions.evidence: to tenants of covered federally assisted rental dwelling units.

dimensions.assessment: Establishes an informational helpline service rather than substantive changes to tenancy rights or housing financial structures.
dimensions.evidence: establish a hotline to provide assistance with regard to eviction-related matters

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes the appropriation of such sums as may be necessary for fiscal year 2026 and subsequent years to operate the hotline.
dimensions.evidence: There is authorized to be appropriated to the Secretary to carry out this section such sums as may be necessary

dimensions.assessment: Directs a specific administrative action by the Secretary of Housing and Urban Development to create a single new communication channel.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary shall, not later than 1 year after the date of the enactment of this Act, establish a hotline

dimensions.assessment: Establishes an ongoing, permanent federal hotline service with continuing authorizations.
dimensions.evidence: for fiscal year 2026 and each fiscal year thereafter.

importance_detail.rationale: The bill requires the HUD Secretary to establish a hotline for eviction-related assistance for tenants in covered federally assisted rental dwelling units and authorizes necessary appropriations.
